purpose: Assess engineering structure, accepted architecture choices and duplicate ownership; recommend the smallest useful change without changing the workspace.
triggers: mature capability appears rebuilt in a new context
duplicate identity state recovery parser or schema ownership signal
explicit engineering paradigm planning or refactor assessment
bounded architectural drift review against project choices
inputs: implementation callers persistence lifecycle and validation evidence
accepted project architecture choices, proposals and any unresolved baseline
validation: analysis remains read-only and labels inference
ownership map traces durable facts and current consumers
deletion recommendations preserve required invariants and failure coverage
no profile task ledger receipt state or external tracker is created
paradigm guidance does not impose a language framework or directory layout
drift requires accepted choices; missing baseline remains an initial assessment
